2109. Dijkstra Algorithm – Shortest Path and Route

70

Hard

Problem Statement
Given a weighted undirected graph represented as an adjacency matrix, find the shortest path from a source vertex to a destination vertex and print both the route and distance.
Input Format
- First line contains n.
- Next n lines contain the adjacency matrix.
- Last line contains source s and destination d.
Output Format
- Print the shortest path.
- Print the shortest distance on the next line.
- If no path exists, print No path.
